The main takeaway from our work is that

the temporal dimension can be exploited to improve video super resolution accuracy and efficiency, and that the proposed algorithms are practical and scalable to real world video super resolution applications.
temporal correlations in video can be effectively leveraged to improve both accuracy and computational efficiency.

the combination of spatio temporal convolutions, early and slow fusion and a novel joint motion estimation and super resolution algorithm provides a simple and effective framework for real time video super resolution.
